invocation.stdin_source: the muse-cauce bridge copies fd 0 to a temporary regular file and passes it as --prompt-file (muse exec rejects a pipe)
invocation.final_event: payload.kind run_terminal; terminal completed carries the final text, run_output_delta is the fallback
invocation.session_mapping: observed stream.id of kind session; --session-id id on resume
invocation.shared_session: SHARED_SESSION=1: the real TUI (muse --yolo --trust-workspace --reasoning-effort max resume <id>) in tmux -L cauce, with an XDG_DATA_HOME of its own under ~/.local/share/cauce-v3/config/<alias>/.local/share
invocation.mcp_registration: none yet: settings.json is shared with every Muse of the container; answers use the JSON envelope text fallback
